name: Origin Enterprises plc
summary: Origin Enterprises plc provides agronomy services company in Ireland, the United Kingdom, Brazil, Poland, Romania, Latin America, and internationally. It operates through two segments: Agriculture and Living Landscapes. The company provides integrated agronomy and on-farm services comprising agronomy advice, services, and inputs to arable, livestock, and fruit and vegetable growers; and seed, nutrition, biologicals, crop protection products; and digital tools and lab testing. It blends and distributes various fertilizers and nutrition products; and animal feed ingredients.
